title: Silo (sell station)
description: The sell station: a red-and-white drive-through bay along Z (corner posts at x +/-6.5, z +/-7, red gable roof on beams at 6 m, white gable ends) with a yellow-bordered dump-pit grate in the middle of its concrete floor, and two tall ribbed galvanised silos with cone roofs and ladders on its +X side, joined by a red bucket-elevator leg with spouts to both cones. Socket_Pit at the bay centre on the ground.
checks: 3/4 tile: a roofed bay open at both Z ends (drive-through), posts only at the four corners
3/4 tile: a dark grate with a yellow border lies in the middle of the bay floor
LEFT tile: two silver silos with cone tops and horizontal bands, a red tower between them with spouts to each cone
RIGHT tile: each silo has a ladder on the side facing the bay
TOP tile: the silos sit to the +X side of the bay, clear of its roof
